routing_protocol_in_use.title: Dynamic Routing Protocol in Use
routing_protocol_in_use.description: The dynamic routing protocol configured on the routing component

routing_protocol_authentication_enabled.title: Routing Protocol Authentication Enabled
routing_protocol_authentication_enabled.description: Whether cryptographic authentication (MD5 or stronger) is configured for the dynamic routing protocol on all active interfaces/peers

routing_authentication_strength.title: Routing Authentication Algorithm Strength
routing_authentication_strength.description: The cryptographic algorithm used for routing protocol authentication when authentication is enabled

bgp_md5_authentication_enabled.title: BGP MD5 Authentication Enabled
bgp_md5_authentication_enabled.description: Indicates whether TCP MD5 authentication is configured for BGP peering sessions to prevent session hijacking and fraudulent route injection.

bgp_session_type.title: BGP Session Type
bgp_session_type.description: Indicates whether the BGP sessions are external (eBGP), internal (iBGP), or mixed, which affects the risk profile of missing authentication.

management_acl_configured.title: Management Plane ACL Configured
management_acl_configured.description: Whether IP-based access control lists are configured to restrict which source addresses can reach management interfaces (SSH, Telnet, SNMP, web UI).

management_protocols_enabled.title: Enabled Management Protocols
management_protocols_enabled.description: List of management protocols currently enabled on the device (e.g., 'telnet', 'snmp_v1', 'snmp_v2c', 'http', 'ssh', 'snmp_v3').

management_source_network.title: Management Allowed Source Network
management_source_network.description: The network range permitted to access management interfaces. A value of '0.0.0.0/0' or '::/0' indicates unrestricted access from any source.

telnet_enabled.title: Telnet Management Enabled
telnet_enabled.description: Indicates whether Telnet (TCP/23) is enabled as a management interface on the routing component, transmitting credentials and configuration in plaintext.

snmp_version.title: SNMP Protocol Version
snmp_version.description: The SNMP version(s) configured on the routing component. SNMPv1 and SNMPv2c transmit community strings and MIB data in plaintext; SNMPv3 provides authentication and encryption.

ssh_enforced_as_exclusive.title: SSH Enforced as Exclusive Management Protocol
ssh_enforced_as_exclusive.description: Indicates whether SSH is configured as the sole permitted management protocol, explicitly disabling all plaintext alternatives on all VTY lines and management interfaces.

default_credentials_unchanged.title: Default Credentials Unchanged
default_credentials_unchanged.description: Indicates whether the device is still using factory-default username/password combinations (e.g., admin/admin, cisco/cisco, admin/blank).

password_complexity_enforced.title: Password Complexity Policy Enforced
password_complexity_enforced.description: Indicates whether the device enforces a password complexity policy (minimum length, character classes) that prevents trivially guessable passwords.

privileged_access_requires_authenticatio.title: Privileged Access Requires Authentication
privileged_access_requires_authenticatio.description: Indicates whether accessing privileged/configuration mode on the device requires a password (e.g., enable secret configured, privileged exec requires credentials).

prefix_list_filter_configured.title: Prefix List Filter Configured
prefix_list_filter_configured.description: Whether prefix-list filters are applied to routing protocol neighbor statements to restrict accepted/advertised routes

route_map_filter_configured.title: Route Map Filter Configured
route_map_filter_configured.description: Whether route-map filters are applied to routing protocol neighbors as an alternative mechanism to restrict route acceptance and propagation

operator_account_privilege_level.title: Operator Account Privilege Level
operator_account_privilege_level.description: The privilege level assigned to operator or read-only monitoring accounts on the routing component.

least_privilege_policy_enforced.title: Least Privilege Policy Enforced
least_privilege_policy_enforced.description: Whether the routing component enforces a least-privilege access policy that restricts operator/monitoring accounts from making configuration changes.

centralized_syslog_configured.title: Centralized Syslog/SIEM Configured
centralized_syslog_configured.description: Whether the routing component is configured to forward logs to a centralized syslog server or SIEM platform

routing_change_logging_enabled.title: Routing Change Event Logging Enabled
routing_change_logging_enabled.description: Whether logging is explicitly enabled for routing table changes, BGP/OSPF/IS-IS session resets, and route redistribution events

config_change_logging_enabled.title: Configuration Change Logging Enabled
config_change_logging_enabled.description: Whether modifications to routing configuration (e.g., ACL changes, redistribution policy edits, prefix-list updates) are logged

firmware_patch_status.title: Firmware/OS Patch Status
firmware_patch_status.description: Whether the routing device firmware or OS is current, behind by minor versions, or significantly out of date relative to the latest vendor security release

known_cve_unpatched.title: Known CVE Without Applied Patch
known_cve_unpatched.description: Whether one or more publicly disclosed CVEs affecting the installed routing OS or firmware version remain unpatched on the device

patch_management_policy_enforced.title: Patch Management Policy Enforced
patch_management_policy_enforced.description: Whether a documented and enforced patch management process exists that ensures routing devices receive security updates within the organization's defined SLA

snmp_community_strings.title: SNMP Community Strings
snmp_community_strings.description: List of SNMP community strings configured on the routing device

snmp_write_access_enabled.title: SNMP Write Access Enabled
snmp_write_access_enabled.description: Indicates whether any SNMP community string is configured with read-write (RW) access, allowing SET operations

snmp_acl_configured.title: SNMP ACL Configured
snmp_acl_configured.description: Indicates whether an access control list (ACL) is applied to restrict which hosts can access SNMP community strings

copp_policy_configured.title: Control Plane Policing Policy Configured
copp_policy_configured.description: Indicates whether a Control Plane Policing (CoPP) or control plane protection policy is actively configured and applied on the router to rate-limit or police traffic destined to the CPU.

cpu_rate_limit_configured.title: CPU Rate Limiting Configured
cpu_rate_limit_configured.description: Indicates whether any platform-level CPU rate limiting or receive ACL (rACL) is configured to restrict the volume of traffic reaching the routing engine CPU, independent of a formal CoPP policy.

plaintext_credential_types_found.title: Plaintext Credential Types Found
plaintext_credential_types_found.description: List of credential types discovered in plaintext within configuration files or backup repositories (e.g., 'routing_protocol_key', 'snmp_community_string', 'management_password', 'bgp_md5_key', 'ospf_key').

credential_storage_encrypted.title: Credential Storage Encrypted
credential_storage_encrypted.description: Whether all credentials stored in configuration files are protected by strong, irreversible encryption. False means at least one credential is stored in plaintext or weakly encrypted form.

ip_source_routing_enabled.title: IP Source Routing Enabled
ip_source_routing_enabled.description: Indicates whether the router accepts and forwards packets with IP source routing options (loose or strict source routing) set in the IP header.

source_routing_scope.title: Source Routing Acceptance Scope
source_routing_scope.description: Defines which interfaces or directions accept source-routed packets: all interfaces, only external-facing interfaces, or none.

acl_blocks_source_routed_packets.title: ACL Blocks Source-Routed Packets
acl_blocks_source_routed_packets.description: Indicates whether an access control list (ACL) is in place to explicitly drop packets carrying IP source routing options, providing a compensating control.

icmp_redirects_enabled.title: ICMP Redirect Messages Enabled
icmp_redirects_enabled.description: Indicates whether the routing interface accepts and processes ICMP redirect messages, allowing external hosts to modify the routing table.

interface_role.title: Interface Role
interface_role.description: The functional role of the routing interface, indicating whether it faces external/untrusted networks or internal trusted segments.

secure_redirects_enabled.title: Secure ICMP Redirects Only
secure_redirects_enabled.description: Indicates whether the interface is configured to accept ICMP redirects only from gateways listed in the routing table (secure redirects), rather than from any host.

ntp_authentication_enabled.title: NTP Authentication Enabled
ntp_authentication_enabled.description: Indicates whether NTP authentication (e.g., MD5 or SHA keys) is configured on the router to validate NTP server identity

ntp_servers_configured.title: NTP Servers Configured
ntp_servers_configured.description: Indicates whether one or more NTP servers are configured on the router, meaning the device is actively attempting time synchronization

ntp_access_group_configured.title: NTP Access Group Restriction Configured
ntp_access_group_configured.description: Indicates whether an NTP access-group (or equivalent ACL) is applied to restrict which peers/servers can interact with the NTP service
